scenes.text: Gemini *Notebook* now lets you *edit the deck* before it builds it

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 19: Notebook's Slide Decks and Video Overviews got co-creation. You see the outline first, change it, then it renders.
Rolling out to all Notebook users through late October.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Client pitch decks. Drop in the client's site, your case studies and a call transcript.
Prompt: 'Ten-slide proposal for a dental clinic: problem, 3 packages, timeline, price.' Fix the outline, render, send.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: It only knows what you upload, so weak sources make a weak deck.
Check every number before a client sees it. Source: Google Keyword blog, Oct 19; Workspace Updates, Oct 21, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Free Notebook accounts get the feature. Google AI Pro ($19.99 a month) raises the daily limits.
A deck that took a day now takes an hour. Bill the same.

scenes.text: Would you send a client an *AI-built deck*? *Yes or no* below.
